title: Hints on extemporaneous preaching
author: Henry Ware

authorInfo.bio: Henry Ware (1794–1843) is the credited author of this historical edition. The source reference provides their catalogue and biographical references.

description: "Hints on Extemporaneous Preaching" by Henry Ware, Jr. is a instructional guide for clergy written in the early 19th century. The work discusses the art of preaching without prepared manuscripts, emphasizing its potential benefits and the necessary discipline to master it.
